ops.title: PR 1316: require root authorship for tap-carry approval
ops.description: Owner: PR #1316 implementation lane (agentic-judge-landing). Static review only; no tests run. Evidence: desk-runner.py:6995-6997, :6808-6815, :6987-6990 and :6664. tap_gos removes synthetic carried gos but accepts direct gos from every configured landing.go_lanes lane, its successors, and RUNNER through head_gos/root_gos. After a tap judge no, a delegated go can therefore carry the owner's tap and bypass TAP-REQUIRED without a root go. Next executable step: restrict this new tap-carry authority check to direct root records while preserving ordinary delegated landing go behavior; add CI coverage for delegated and runner-authored gos.

ops.text: A delegated lane or desk-runner go never authorizes a non-identical tap carry or clears kept_by_go.
A direct root go at the target head authorizes the cleared carry.
